items.claim: Cody Gibson is taking this fight on short notice, which could hinder his cardio and make him vulnerable to a submission.
items.quote: I do think the short notice step up could really kind of hinder Cody Gibson's overall cardio. It could allow him to be more vulnerable for a potential submission attempt from Abdul Hussein.

items.claim: Ruel Alif is primarily a decision fighter who rarely finishes opponents.
items.quote: Royal Alif he is a decision dator. He is not finishing hardly anyone

items.claim: Mike Davis has not been finished or submitted since his loss to Gilbert Burns years ago.
items.quote: he doesn't really have he has not been submitted or finished since.

items.claim: Momed Tuchilov has a lot of knockout power in his hands and knees and frequently finishes opponents early.
items.quote: He gets guys out of there early. He has a lot of knockout power in the hands and particularly in the knees as well.

items.claim: Brenson Rivero has poor durability and is most commonly knocked out in the very first round.
items.quote: he's chinny. It's a real concern in terms of his overall durability when he's getting knocked out. It's most commonly in the very first round.

items.claim: Axel Sola does not have brute force knockout power to run right through his opponent early.
items.quote: Axel Solola this type of guy where he has this brute force knockout power he's just going to absolutely run right through Ishmael Bonfam

items.claim: Ishmael Bonfam can make the fight competitive early in the first round when he is fresh.
items.quote: I think Ishmael Bonfam could make this fight pretty competitive early on especially in that first round when he is fresh
